title: Signature Co-Occurrence Mining — Core Method
description: Signature original by Justin Addam Higgins. Concepts that appear together often are probably related: co-occurrence mining counts how many records mention each pair and ranks pairs by raw frequency. It needs no labels and no training — just counting over the archive. Raw counts favor common terms, so co-occurrence is usually the first pass before smarter scoring. Even this simple counting surfaces relationships no one wrote down, like which techniques appear alongside which problems. At ladder rank 1 this is the simple core: a single, self-contained application of the method. Lineage: Signature-line counterpart of the public method of the same name, filed as a Signature original in the Signature archive.
provenance: JAH Databases archive-intelligence tools program, lane T2a — Signature original authored for Justin Addam Higgins.

title: Signature PMI Scoring — Core Method
description: Signature original by Justin Addam Higgins. Pointwise mutual information fixes co-occurrence's popularity bias: it scores a pair by how much more often they co-occur than chance would predict. A rare pair that always appears together scores high; a common pair that meets at random scores near zero. PMI is computed from the same counts as co-occurrence, just normalized by the marginals. This turns 'appears together a lot' into 'appears together surprisingly often', which is the actual signal of a relationship. At ladder rank 1 this is the simple core: a single, self-contained application of the method. Lineage: Signature-line counterpart of the public method of the same name, filed as a Signature original in the Signature archive.
demo:
import math
N, c_ab, c_a, c_b = 1000, 40, 100, 80
pmi = math.log((c_ab / N) / ((c_a / N) * (c_b / N)))
print("PMI(a,b) = %.2f -> %s" % (pmi, "related" if pmi > 1 else "weak"))

title: Signature Association Rules — Core Method
description: Signature original by Justin Addam Higgins. Association rules go beyond pairs to implications: records mentioning A also mention B with confidence X and lift Y. Support filters out flukes, confidence measures reliability, and lift measures surprise versus independence. Mined rules read like discovered knowledge — 'caching implies performance work' — each with numbers to back it. Market-basket analysis invented this machinery for shopping carts; archives use it to find which ideas travel together. At ladder rank 1 this is the simple core: a single, self-contained application of the method. Lineage: Signature-line counterpart of the public method of the same name, filed as a Signature original in the Signature archive.
demo:
both, a_only = 30, 70
support, confidence = both / 200, both / (both + a_only)
print("support=%.2f confidence=%.2f" % (support, confidence))
provenance: JAH Databases archive-intelligence tools program, lane T2a — Signature original authored for Justin Addam Higgins.

title: Signature Implicit Link Inference — Core Method
description: Signature original by Justin Addam Higgins. Some relationships are never stated but implied: A relates to B, B relates to C, so A may relate to C through B. The miner follows two-hop paths in the co-occurrence graph and proposes the implied links, scored by the product of the hop strengths. Proposals are labeled inferred and ranked below directly observed relationships. Multi-hop inference is how the miner discovers connections that no single record contains — genuine discovery, not just indexing. At ladder rank 1 this is the simple core: a single, self-contained application of the method. Lineage: Signature-line counterpart of the public method of the same name, filed as a Signature original in the Signature archive.

title: Signature Relationship Ranking — Core Method
description: Signature original by Justin Addam Higgins. Candidate relationships pour in from every miner, so the ranker orders them by a combined score: statistical strength, source diversity, recency, and corroboration across methods. A relationship found by both PMI and association rules outranks one found by a single method. The ranked list is the miner's product — top entries are worth a human's attention, the tail is noise. Ranking turns discovery from a firehose into a briefing. At ladder rank 1 this is the simple core: a single, self-contained application of the method. Lineage: Signature-line counterpart of the public method of the same name, filed as a Signature original in the Signature archive.
